en.headline: CityUHK’s Power of Play exhibition on gaming history closes this weekend
en.dek: The free interactive show at the Indra and Harry Banga Gallery runs until 25 October, tracing 5,000 years of play from ancient board games to modern esports.
body: The Power of Play, an interactive exhibition at City University of Hong Kong’s Indra and Harry Banga Gallery, closes on Sunday after running since early July.

Curated by Professor Espen Aarseth, Dean of the School of Creative Media, the show marks the gallery’s tenth anniversary. It presents games as cultural and technological forms rather than mere entertainment, spanning ancient Egyptian board games, arcade history, virtual-reality environments, esports and collaborative robotics.

The gallery is on the 18th floor of the Lau Ming Wai Academic Building. It opens from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. Tuesday to Sunday and is free, though prior online registration is recommended for visitors not affiliated with the university.
The organisers said the exhibition examines how attitudes toward play have shifted over time and includes playable works alongside historical artefacts.

zh.headline: 城大《游於藝乎》遊戲史展覽本周末閉幕
zh.dek: 般哥展覽館免費互動展至10月25日止，追溯五千年遊戲文化，從古埃及桌遊到現代電競。
body: 香港城市大學般哥展覽館的《游於藝乎》（The Power of Play）互動展覽將於本周日閉幕，自七月初起展出。
展覽由創意媒體學院院長艾斯本・阿爾薩斯教授策展，適逢展覽館十周年。它將遊戲視為文化與科技形式，而非純粹娛樂，涵蓋古埃及桌遊、街機歷史、虛擬實境、電競及協作機械人。
展覽館位於劉鳴煒學術樓18樓，周二至日上午11時至晚上7時開放，免費入場，非城大人士建議事先網上預約。
主辦方表示，展覽探討人們對「玩」的態度如何隨時間改變，並設有可玩作品及歷史文物。
